title: Security Deposit Anniversary Interest Across Two Calendar Years
content:
**Rule on the rate earned over the year being credited on a Security Deposit anniversary.**

The year being credited begins on the period end of the latest interest credit on the deposit, or on the fully secured date when no interest has been credited yet, and ends on the anniversary, covering the 12 months ending on it. The closing year's rate is the Commission rate of the calendar year of the anniversary: 3.85% (0.0385) for 2024, 4.02% (0.0402) for 2025 and 4.17% (0.0417) for 2026 on, the last being the annual interest rate of every Security Deposit kind. Days are counted from the start date to the end date, the start date not counted.

1. Where the year being credited began in an earlier calendar year than its anniversary and that earlier year's rate differs from the closing year's rate, its days up to and including 31 December of that earlier year earn the earlier year's rate and its days from 1 January of the anniversary's year on earn the closing year's rate, each counted as days over 365.
2. Where the period credited is shorter than 365 days and earns a single year's rate, its days earn the closing year's rate as days over 365.
3. Otherwise the whole year earns the closing year's rate.

## Worked cases (hypothetical periods)

**Period from 12 May 2025 to 12 May 2026.** It began in 2025 (rate 4.02%) and closes in 2026 (rate 4.17%); the rates differ, so clause 1 applies. Days from 13 May to 31 December 2025: 233. Days from 1 January to 12 May 2026: 132. Rate earned over the period: 233 days times 4.02% plus 132 days times 4.17%, over 365, which is 1487.10 percentage-days over 365, about 4.0742%.

**Period from 20 February 2026 to 12 May 2026.** It lies within one calendar year, so a single rate applies, and it is 81 days long, shorter than 365. Clause 2 applies: 81 days over 365 at 4.17%.

**Period from 1 August 2026 to 1 August 2027.** Both calendar years carry 4.17%, so no split arises, and the period is 365 days. Clause 3 applies: the whole year earns 4.17%.

| Began in an earlier calendar year with a different rate | Shorter than 365 days | Rate earned |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Either | Split by days at each year's rate, days over 365 |
| No | Yes | Closing year's rate times days over 365 |
| No | No | Closing year's rate for the whole year |
